Reckless.de: Erhöht die Stärke von Attacken mit Rückstoßschaden.
Reckless.en: This Pokemon's attacks with recoil or crash damage have their power multiplied by 1.2. Does not affect Struggle.

Keen Eye.de: Sein scharfer Blick hindert Angreifer daran, seine Genauigkeit zu senken.
Keen Eye.en: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's accuracy stat stage. This Pokemon ignores a target's evasiveness stat stage.

Guts.de: Bei Statusproblemen setzt es Adrenalin frei und erhöht so seinen Angriffs-Wert.
Guts.en: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Attack is multiplied by 1.5. This Pokemon's physical attacks ignore the burn effect of halving damage.

Analytic.de: Greift das Pokémon zuletzt an, erhöht sich die Stärke der Attacke, die es einsetzt.
Analytic.en: The power of this Pokemon's move is multiplied by 1.3 if it is the last to move in a turn. Does not affect Doom Desire and Future Sight.

Adaptability.en: This Pokemon's moves that match one of its types have a same-type attack bonus (STAB) of 2 instead of 1.5.

Unnerve.de: Gegner können während des Kampfes keine Beeren essen.
Unnerve.en: While this Pokemon is active, it prevents opposing Pokemon from using their Berries. This Ability activates before hazards and other Abilities take effect.

Poison Heal.de: Das Pokémon erleidet keinen Schaden durch Vergiftung, sondern regeneriert KP.
Poison Heal.en: If this Pokemon is poisoned, it restores 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn instead of losing HP.

Cheek Pouch.de: Regeneriert beim Konsum von Beeren ungeachtet der Beerensorte KP.
Cheek Pouch.en: If this Pokemon eats a held Berry, it restores 1/3 of its maximum HP, rounded down, in addition to the Berry's effect. This effect can also activate after the effects of Bug Bite, Fling, Pluck, Stuff Cheeks, and Teatime if the eaten Berry had an effect on this Pokemon.

Intimidate.de: Senkt beim Einwechseln den Angriff aller direkten Gegner um 1 Stufe.
Intimidate.en: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the Attack of opposing Pokemon by 1 stage. Pokemon with the Inner Focus, Oblivious, Own Tempo, or Scrappy Abilities and Pokemon behind a substitute are immune.

Regenerator.de: Wird das Pokémon ausgewechselt, regeneriert es eine kleine Menge an KP.
Regenerator.en: This Pokemon restores 1/3 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when it switches out.

Lightning Rod.de: Zieht Elektro-Attacken an. Statt durch diese Schaden zu nehmen, erhöht es den eigenen Spezial-Angriff.
Lightning Rod.en: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Special Attack by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move. If this Pokemon is not the target of a single-target Electric-type move used by another Pokemon, this Pokemon redirects that move to itself if it is within the range of that move. If multiple Pokemon could redirect with this Ability, it goes to the one with the highest Speed, or in the case of a tie to the one that has had this Ability active longer.

Flower Veil.de: Verbündete Pflanzen-Pokémon können keine Statusprobleme erleiden und keine Werte-Senkungen durch den Gegner.
Flower Veil.en: Grass-type Pokemon on this Pokemon's side cannot have their stat stages lowered by other Pokemon or have a non-volatile status condition inflicted on them by other Pokemon.

Earth Eater.de: This Pokemon is immune to Ground-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by a Ground-type move.
Earth Eater.en: This Pokemon is immune to Ground-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by a Ground-type move.

Weak Armor.de: Senkt bei erlittenem Treffer durch eine physische Attacke die Verteidigung des Pokémon, aber erhöht dafür seine Initiative stark.
Weak Armor.en: If a physical attack hits this Pokemon, its Defense is lowered by 1 stage and its Speed is raised by 2 stages.

Big Pecks.de: Hindert Angreifer daran, die Verteidigung des Pokémon zu senken.
Big Pecks.en: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's Defense stat stage.

Cute Charm.de: Wird dieses Pokémon durch eine direkte Attacke angegriffen, verliebt sich der Gegner eventuell in es.
Cute Charm.en: There is a 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will become infatuated if it is of the opposite gender.

Spicy Spray.de: If this Pokemon is hit by an attack, the attacker becomes burned.
Spicy Spray.en: If this Pokemon is hit by an attack, the attacker becomes burned.

Chlorophyll.en: If Sunny Day is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

Imposter.en: On switch-in, this Pokemon Transforms into the opposing Pokemon that is facing it. If there is no Pokemon at that position, this Pokemon does not Transform.

Dragonize.de: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.
Dragonize.en: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.

Aroma Veil.de: Kann alle Team-Pokémon vor mentalen Angriffen schützen.
Aroma Veil.en: This Pokemon and its allies cannot become affected by Attract, Disable, Encore, Heal Block, Taunt, or Torment.

Stench.de: Lässt das Ziel beim Angriff eventuell durch Gestank zurückschrecken.
Stench.en: This Pokemon's attacks without a chance to make the target flinch gain a 10% chance to make the target flinch.

Electromorphosis.de: This Pokemon gains the Charge effect when it takes a hit from an attack.
Electromorphosis.en: This Pokemon gains the Charge effect when it takes a hit from an attack.

Oblivious.de: Das Pokémon ist so apathisch, dass es nicht betört oder provoziert werden kann.
Oblivious.en: This Pokemon cannot be infatuated or taunted. Gaining this Ability while infatuated or taunted cures it. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

Drought.de: Erzeugt beim Einwechseln 5 Runden harsches Sonnenlicht (8 mit Heißbrocken).
Drought.en: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sunny Day.

Iron Fist.de: Erhöht die Stärke von Hieb-, Punch-, Faust- und Schlag-Attacken.
Iron Fist.en: This Pokemon's punch-based attacks have their power multiplied by 1.2.

Ice Body.de: Regeneriert bei Hagel nach und nach KP.
Ice Body.en: If Snow is active, this Pokemon restores 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn.

Unburden.de: Initiative ×2, sobald das getragene Item verbraucht wurde.
Unburden.en: If this Pokemon loses its held item for any reason, its Speed is doubled as long as it remains active, has this Ability, and is not holding an item.

Trace.de: Kopiert bei Kampfantritt die Fähigkeit eines Gegners.
Trace.en: On switch-in, this Pokemon copies a random opposing Pokemon's Ability. Abilities that cannot be copied are As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Teraform Zero, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Trace, Zen Mode, and Zero to Hero. If no opposing Pokemon has an Ability that can be copied, this Ability will activate as soon as one does.

Illuminate.de: Erhellt die Umgebung und erhöht dadurch die Wahrscheinlichkeit, wilden Pokémon zu begegnen.
Illuminate.en: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's accuracy stat stage. This Pokemon ignores a target's evasiveness stat stage.

Pressure.de: Zwingt Gegner dazu, beim Einsatz von Attacken mehr AP zu verbrauchen.
Pressure.en: If this Pokemon is the target of an opposing Pokemon's move, that move loses one additional PP. Imprison, Snatch, and Tera Blast also lose one additional PP when used by an opposing Pokemon, but Sticky Web does not.

Shed Skin.de: Das Pokémon befreit sich eventuell von Statusproblemen, indem es seine Haut abstreift.
Shed Skin.en: This Pokemon has a 33% chance to have its non-volatile status condition cured at the end of each turn.

Compound Eyes.en: This Pokemon's moves have their accuracy multiplied by 1.3.

Parental Bond.de: Zwei Generationen setzen jeweils ein Mal zum Angriff an.
Parental Bond.en: This Pokemon's damaging moves become multi-hit moves that hit twice. The second hit has its damage quartered. Does not affect Doom Desire, Dragon Darts, Dynamax Cannon, Endeavor, Explosion, Final Gambit, Fling, Future Sight, Ice Ball, Rollout, Self-Destruct, any multi-hit move, any move that has multiple targets, or any two-turn move.

Fairy Aura.de: Alle Fee-Attacken (auch gegnerische) machen 33 % mehr Schaden.
Fairy Aura.en: While this Pokemon is active, the power of Fairy-type moves used by active Pokemon is multiplied by 1.33.

Pixilate.de: Normal-Attacken des Trägers werden zu Fee-Attacken und +20 % Schaden.
Pixilate.en: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.

Supreme Overlord.de: This Pokemon's moves have their power multiplied by 1+(X*0.1), where X is the total number of times any Pokemon has fainted on the user's side when this Ability became active, and X cannot be greater than 5.
Supreme Overlord.en: This Pokemon's moves have their power multiplied by 1+(X*0.1), where X is the total number of times any Pokemon has fainted on the user's side when this Ability became active, and X cannot be greater than 5.

Fur Coat.de: Halbiert den Schaden, den das Pokémon durch physische Attacken erleidet.

Steadfast.de: Sein eiserner Wille erhöht die Initiative, wann immer das Pokémon zurückschreckt.
Steadfast.en: If this Pokemon flinches, its Speed is raised by 1 stage.

Solid Rock.de: Reduziert die Stärke von sehr effektiven Attacken und verringert damit den Schaden, den das Pokémon durch sie erleidet.
Solid Rock.en: This Pokemon receives 3/4 damage from supereffective attacks.

Damp.de: Befeuchtet die Umgebung und verhindert so den Einsatz von Attacken wie Finale, die Explosionen auslösen.
Damp.en: While this Pokemon is active, Explosion, Mind Blown, Misty Explosion, Self-Destruct, and the Aftermath Ability are prevented from having an effect.

Flash Fire.de: Immun gegen Feuer-Attacken; eigene Feuer-Attacken werden danach um 50 % stärker.
Flash Fire.en: This Pokemon is immune to Fire-type moves. The first time it is hit by a Fire-type move, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Fire-type attack as long as it remains active and has this Ability. If this Pokemon is frozen, it cannot be defrosted by Fire-type attacks.

Filter.de: Reduziert die Stärke von sehr effektiven Attacken und verringert damit den Schaden, den das Pokémon durch sie erleidet.
Filter.en: This Pokemon receives 3/4 damage from supereffective attacks.

Aftermath.de: Wird das Pokémon durch eine direkte Attacke besiegt, fügt es dem Angreifer Schaden zu.
Aftermath.en: If this Pokemon is knocked out with a contact move, that move's user loses 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down. This effect is prevented if the move's user has the Magic Guard Ability or if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.

Flame Body.de: Fügt dem Angreifer bei Berührung eventuell Verbrennungen zu.
Flame Body.en: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be burned.

Limber.de: Der flexible Körper des Pokémon schützt es vor Paralyse.
Limber.en: This Pokemon cannot be paralyzed. Gaining this Ability while paralyzed cures it.

Leaf Guard.en: If Sunny Day is active, this Pokemon cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn, and Rest will fail for it. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

Friend Guard.de: Kann den Schaden, den Mitstreiter erleiden, verringern.
Friend Guard.en: This Pokemon's allies receive 3/4 damage from other Pokemon's attacks.

Battle Bond.de: Besiegt es ein Ziel, vertieft dies die Freundschaft zu seinem Trainer, wodurch es die Ash-Form annimmt und sein Wasser-Shuriken stärker wird.
Battle Bond.en: If this Pokemon is a Greninja, its Attack, Special Attack, and Speed are raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon. This effect can only happen once per battle.

Refrigerate.de: Attacken vom Typ Normal nehmen den Typ Eis an und ihre Stärke erhöht sich ein wenig.
Refrigerate.en: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Ice-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.

Early Bird.de: Wenn es eingeschlafen ist, kann es doppelt so schnell wieder aufwachen wie andere Pokémon.
Early Bird.en: This Pokemon's sleep counter drops by 2 instead of 1.

Tangled Feet.de: Erhöht den Ausweichwert, wenn das Pokémon verwirrt ist.
Tangled Feet.en: This Pokemon's evasiveness is doubled as long as it is confused.

Hospitality.de: Beim Einwechseln: Verbündeter heilt 1/4 max. KP.
Hospitality.en: On switch-in, this Pokemon restores 1/4 of its ally's maximum HP, rounded down.

Moody.de: Erhöht in jeder Runde aufs Neue einen Statuswert stark und senkt einen anderen.
Moody.en: This Pokemon has a random stat, other than accuracy or evasiveness, raised by 2 stages and another stat lowered by 1 stage at the end of each turn.

Toxic Debris.de: Legt eine Lage Giftspitzen auf die Gegnerseite, wenn der Träger physischen Schaden erleidet.
Toxic Debris.en: If this Pokemon is hit by a physical attack, Toxic Spikes are set on the opposing side.

Poison Point.de: Vergiftet den Angreifer bei Berührung eventuell.
Poison Point.en: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be poisoned.

Poison Touch.de: 30 % Chance, ein Ziel zu vergiften, das per Kontakt getroffen wird.
Poison Touch.en: This Pokemon's contact moves have a 30% chance of poisoning. This effect comes after a move's inherent secondary effect chance.

Super Luck.de: Großes Glück erhöht die Wahrscheinlichkeit, einen Volltreffer zu landen.
Super Luck.en: This Pokemon's critical hit ratio is raised by 1 stage.

Blaze.de: Feuer-Attacken machen 50 % mehr Schaden, wenn die KP des Trägers ≤ 1/3 sind.
Blaze.en: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Fire-type attack.

Water Absorb.de: Treffer durch Wasser-Attacken verursachen keinen Schaden, sondern regenerieren stattdessen KP.
Water Absorb.en: This Pokemon is immune to Water-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by a Water-type move.

Snow Warning.de: Lässt es beim Einwechseln 5 Runden schneien (8 mit Eisbrocken).
Snow Warning.en: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Snow.

Healer.en: 30% chance this Pokemon's ally has its non-volatile status condition cured at the end of each turn.

Hunger Switch.de: Das Pokémon ändert zum Ende jeder Runde seine Form und wechselt somit zwischen dem Pappsatt- und dem Kohldampfmuster.
Hunger Switch.en: If this Pokemon is a Morpeko, it changes formes between its Full Belly Mode and Hangry Mode at the end of each turn.

Screen Cleaner.de: Hebt bei Kampfantritt die Wirkung von Lichtschild, Reflektor und Auroraschleier auf Mitstreiter- und Gegnerseite auf.
Screen Cleaner.en: On switch-in, the effects of Aurora Veil, Light Screen, and Reflect end for both sides.

Ripen.de: Verdoppelt den Effekt von Beeren, indem es sie heranreifen lässt.
Ripen.en: When this Pokemon eats certain Berries, the effects are doubled. Berries that restore HP or PP have the amount doubled, Berries that raise stat stages have the amount doubled, Berries that halve damage taken quarter it instead, and a Jaboca Berry or Rowap Berry has the attacker lose 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down.

Swarm.de: Erhöht die Stärke von Käfer-Attacken, wenn die KP auf einen gewissen Wert fallen.
Swarm.en: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Bug-type attack.

Heatproof.de: Sein Hitze abweisender Körper halbiert den durch Feuer-Attacken erlittenen Schaden.
Heatproof.en: If a Pokemon uses a Fire-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon. This Pokemon takes half of the usual burn damage, rounded down.

Moxie.de: Besiegt es ein Pokémon, steigt sein Selbstvertrauen und somit auch sein Angriff.
Moxie.en: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon.

Hydration.en: This Pokemon has its non-volatile status condition cured at the end of each turn if Rain Dance is active. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

Immunity.de: Das starke Immunsystem des Pokémon verhindert Vergiftungen.
Immunity.en: This Pokemon cannot be poisoned. Gaining this Ability while poisoned cures it.

Natural Cure.de: Wird das Pokémon ausgewechselt, werden seine Statusprobleme geheilt.
Natural Cure.en: This Pokemon has its non-volatile status condition cured when it switches out.

Insomnia.en: This Pokemon cannot fall asleep. Gaining this Ability while asleep cures it.

Sticky Hold.de: Trägt es ein Item, bleibt dieses an seinem klebrigen Körper haften, wodurch Item-Diebstahl verhindert wird.
Sticky Hold.en: This Pokemon cannot lose its held item due to another Pokemon's Ability or attack, unless the attack knocks out this Pokemon. A Sticky Barb will be transferred to other Pokemon regardless of this Ability.

Inner Focus.de: Immun gegen Zurückzucken; immun gegen Bedroher beim Einwechseln.
Inner Focus.en: This Pokemon cannot be made to flinch. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

Corrosion.de: Kann selbst Pokémon vom Typ Stahl oder Gift vergiften.
Corrosion.en: This Pokemon can poison or badly poison a Pokemon regardless of its typing.

Disguise.de: Kann ein Mal pro Kampf mit seinem gruseligen Kostüm einen Angriff abwehren.
Disguise.en: If this Pokemon is a Mimikyu, the first hit it takes in battle deals 0 neutral damage. Its disguise is then broken, it changes to Busted Form, and it loses 1/8 of its max HP. Confusion damage also breaks the disguise.

Huge Power.de: Verdoppelt die Stärke von physischen Attacken.

Tough Claws.de: Erhöht die Stärke von direkten Attacken.
Tough Claws.en: This Pokemon's contact moves have their power multiplied by 1.3.

Bulletproof.de: Kann das Pokémon vor geworfenen kugelförmigen Objekten, wie zum Beispiel Bomben, schützen.
Bulletproof.en: This Pokemon is immune to bullet moves.

Curious Medicine.de: Das Pokémon versprüht bei Kampfantritt Arznei aus seiner Muschel, die alle Statusveränderungen auf der Mitstreiterseite aufhebt.
Curious Medicine.en: On switch-in, this Pokemon's allies have their stat stages reset to 0.

Anger Point.de: Wird nach Einstecken eines Volltreffers wütend und maximiert dabei seinen Angriffs-Wert.
Anger Point.en: If this Pokemon, but not its substitute, is struck by a critical hit, its Attack is raised by 12 stages.

Pickpocket.de: Stiehlt das Item des Angreifers bei Berührung.
Pickpocket.en: If this Pokemon has no item and is hit by a contact move, it steals the attacker's item. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability.

Long Reach.de: Ermöglicht dem Pokémon den Einsatz aller seiner Attacken, ohne das Ziel dabei direkt zu berühren.
Long Reach.en: This Pokemon's attacks do not make contact with the target.

Light Metal.en: This Pokemon's weight is halved, rounded down to a tenth of a kilogram. This effect is calculated after the effect of Autotomize, and before the effect of Float Stone. A Pokemon's weight will not drop below 0.1 kg.

Soundproof.de: Immun gegen alle Schall-Attacken (z. B. Hyperstimme, Lärmbringer).
Soundproof.en: This Pokemon is immune to sound-based moves, unless it used the move.

Purifying Salt.de: This Pokemon cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn. If a Pokemon uses a Ghost-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon.
Purifying Salt.en: This Pokemon cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn. If a Pokemon uses a Ghost-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon.

Innards Out.de: Wird es durch eine Attacke besiegt, fügt es dem Angreifer Schaden in Höhe des KP-Werts zu, den es besaß, bevor es kampfunfähig wurde.
Innards Out.en: If this Pokemon is knocked out with a move, that move's user loses HP equal to the amount of damage inflicted on this Pokemon.

Magic Guard.de: Das Pokémon nimmt nur durch Offensiv-Attacken Schaden.
Magic Guard.en: This Pokemon can only be damaged by direct attacks. Curse and Substitute on use, Belly Drum, Pain Split, Struggle recoil, and confusion damage are considered direct damage.

Magic Bounce.de: Lenkt Status-Attacken auf den Angreifer um, ohne selbst von ihnen getroffen zu werden.
Magic Bounce.en: This Pokemon is unaffected by certain non-damaging moves directed at it and will instead use such moves against the original user. Moves reflected in this way are unable to be reflected again by this or Magic Coat's effect. Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes can only be reflected once per side, by the leftmost Pokemon under this or Magic Coat's effect. The Lightning Rod and Storm Drain Abilities redirect their respective moves before this Ability takes effect.

Magma Armor.de: Dank eines Panzers aus Magma kann dieses Pokémon nicht eingefroren werden.
Magma Armor.en: This Pokemon cannot be frozen. Gaining this Ability while frozen cures it.

Queenly Majesty.de: Vorzugsangriffe gegen den Träger oder seine Verbündeten schlagen fehl.
Queenly Majesty.en: Priority moves used by opposing Pokemon targeting this Pokemon or its allies are prevented from having an effect.

Mega Sol.de: This Pokemon's moves are used as if the effects of Sunny Day were active.
Mega Sol.en: This Pokemon's moves are used as if the effects of Sunny Day were active.

Mega Launcher.de: Erhöht die Stärke einiger Wellen-, Aura- und Puls-Attacken.
Mega Launcher.en: This Pokemon's pulse moves have their power multiplied by 1.5. Heal Pulse restores 3/4 of a target's maximum HP, rounded half down.

Pure Power.de: Verdoppelt mit reiner Willenskraft die Stärke seiner physischen Attacken.

Mimicry.de: Der Typ des Pokémon ändert sich in Abhängigkeit vom Zustand des Feldes.
Mimicry.en: This Pokemon's types change to match the active Terrain when this Pokemon acquires this Ability, or whenever a Terrain begins. Electric type during Electric Terrain, Grass type during Grassy Terrain, Fairy type during Misty Terrain, and Psychic type during Psychic Terrain. If this Ability is acquired without an active Terrain, or a Terrain ends, this Pokemon's types become the original types for its species.

Minus.de: Erhöht den Spezial-Angriff, wenn das Pokémon einen Mitstreiter mit der Fähigkeit Plus oder Minus hat.
Minus.en: If an active ally has this Ability or the Plus Ability, this Pokemon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5.

Pickup.de: Hebt gelegentlich von Gegnern benutzte Items auf. Dies geschieht nicht nur während Kämpfen, sondern auch unterwegs.
Pickup.en: At the end of each turn, if this Pokemon is not holding an item and at least one adjacent Pokemon used an item during this turn, one of those Pokemon is selected at random and this Pokemon obtains that Pokemon's last used item. An item is not considered the last used if it was a popped Air Balloon, if the item was picked up by another Pokemon with this Ability, or if the item was lost to Bug Bite, Corrosive Gas, Covet, Incinerate, Knock Off, Pluck, or Thief. Items thrown with Fling can be picked up.

Multiscale.de: Verringert den erlittenen Schaden bei vollen KP.
Multiscale.en: If this Pokemon is at full HP, damage taken from attacks is halved.

Mummy.de: Überträgt bei Berührung die Fähigkeit Mumie auf den Angreifer.
Mummy.en: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability changed to Mummy. Does not affect Pokemon with the As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Mummy, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero Abilities.

Clear Body.de: Verhindert das Senken der Statuswerte durch Attacken und Fähigkeiten von Angreifern.
Clear Body.en: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.

Drizzle.de: Erzeugt beim Einwechseln 5 Runden Regen (8 mit Nassbrocken).
Drizzle.en: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Rain Dance.

Overgrow.de: Pflanzen-Attacken machen 50 % mehr Schaden bei KP ≤ 1/3.
Overgrow.en: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Grass-type attack.

Marvel Scale.de: Bei Statusproblemen schützt es sich mit mysteriösen Schuppen und erhöht so seine Verteidigung.
Marvel Scale.en: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Defense is multiplied by 1.5.

Symbiosis.de: Gibt Mitstreitern, die ihr Item aufgebraucht haben, sein eigenes Item.
Symbiosis.en: If an ally uses its item, this Pokemon gives its item to that ally immediately. Does not activate if the ally's item was stolen or knocked off, or if the ally used an Eject Button or Eject Pack.

Gale Wings.de: Flug-Attacken erhalten Vorrang (Priorität +1), aber NUR wenn der Träger volle KP hat.
Gale Wings.en: If this Pokemon is at full HP, its Flying-type moves have their priority increased by 1.

Shell Armor.de: Wehrt gegnerische Volltreffer mit einem harten Panzer ab.
Shell Armor.en: This Pokemon cannot be struck by a critical hit.

Overcoat.de: Nimmt weder durch Wetterlagen wie Sandsturm oder Hagel noch durch Pulver oder Puder Schaden.
Overcoat.en: This Pokemon is immune to powder moves, damage from Sandstorm, and the effects of Rage Powder and the Effect Spore Ability.

Plus.de: Erhöht den Spezial-Angriff, wenn das Pokémon einen Mitstreiter mit der Fähigkeit Plus oder Minus hat.
Plus.en: If an active ally has this Ability or the Minus Ability, this Pokemon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5.

Liquid Voice.de: Schall-Attacken (z. B. Hyperstimme) des Trägers werden zu Wasser-Attacken.
Liquid Voice.en: This Pokemon's sound-based moves become Water-type moves. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.

Opportunist.de: When an opposing Pokemon has a stat stage raised, this Pokemon copies the effect.
Opportunist.en: When an opposing Pokemon has a stat stage raised, this Pokemon copies the effect.

Forecast.de: Nimmt je nach Wetter entweder den Typ Wasser, Feuer oder Eis an.
Forecast.en: If this Pokemon is a Castform, its type changes to the current weather condition's type, except Sandstorm. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella and the weather is Rain Dance or Sunny Day.

Shield Dust.de: Blockiert durch Puder die Zusatzeffekte gegnerischer Angriffe.
Shield Dust.en: This Pokemon is not affected by the secondary effect of another Pokemon's attack. Attacks with secondary effects that are prevented include those with a chance (even 100%) to paralyze, sleep, freeze, burn, poison, confuse, cause this Pokemon to flinch, cause this Pokemon's stat stages to be lowered, as well as Anchor Shot, Eerie Spell, Fling, Psychic Noise, Salt Cure, Spirit Shackle, Syrup Bomb, and Throat Chop. The effect of Sparkling Aria is prevented if this Pokemon is the only target. Secondary effects added by King's Rock, Razor Fang, and the Poison Touch, Stench, and Toxic Chain Abilities are also prevented against this Pokemon.

White Smoke.de: Indem es sich mit pulvrigem Rauch umhüllt, hindert es Angreifer daran, seine Statuswerte zu senken.
White Smoke.en: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.

Merciless.de: Sorgt bei Angriffen auf vergiftete Ziele für Volltreffergarantie.
Merciless.en: This Pokemon's attacks are critical hits if the target is poisoned.

Quick Feet.en: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Speed is multiplied by 1.5. This Pokemon ignores the paralysis effect of halving Speed.

Wandering Spirit.de: Wird das Pokémon von einer direkten Attacke getroffen, tauscht es seine Fähigkeit mit der des Angreifers.
Wandering Spirit.en: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability swapped with this one. Does not affect Pokemon with the Abilities As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

Scrappy.de: Bewirkt, dass Normal- und Kampf-Attacken auch Pokémon vom Typ Geist treffen können.
Scrappy.en: This Pokemon can hit Ghost types with Normal- and Fighting-type moves. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

Rough Skin.en: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon lose 1/8 of their maximum HP, rounded down.

Receiver.de: Wird einer seiner Mitstreiter besiegt, erhält es dessen Fähigkeit.
Receiver.en: This Pokemon copies the Ability of an ally that faints. Abilities that cannot be copied are As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, and Zero to Hero.

Justified.de: Wird es von einer Unlicht-Attacke getroffen, meldet sich sein Sinn für Gerechtigkeit zu Wort und sein Angriff steigt.
Justified.en: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage after it is damaged by a Dark-type move.

Rain Dish.de: Regeneriert bei Regen nach und nach KP.
Rain Dish.en: If Rain Dance is active, this Pokemon restores 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

Harvest.de: Dieselbe Beere kann mehrmals verwendet werden.
Harvest.en: If the last item this Pokemon used is a Berry, there is a 50% chance it gets restored at the end of each turn. If Sunny Day is active, this chance is 100%.

Rivalry.de: Greift es einen Rivalen desselben Geschlechts an, wird es stärker. Greift es ein Ziel des anderen Geschlechts an, wird es schwächer.
Rivalry.en: This Pokemon's attacks have their power multiplied by 1.25 against targets of the same gender or multiplied by 0.75 against targets of the opposite gender. There is no modifier if either this Pokemon or the target is genderless.

Sturdy.de: Bietet Schutz gegen K.O.-Attacken. Bei vollen KP übersteht das Pokémon auch K.O.-Treffer.
Sturdy.en: If this Pokemon is at full HP, it survives one hit with at least 1 HP. OHKO moves fail when used against this Pokemon.

Sheer Force.de: Erhöht die Stärke von Attacken, aber hebt dafür ihre Zusatzeffekte auf.
Sheer Force.en: This Pokemon's attacks with secondary effects have their power multiplied by 1.3, but the secondary effects are removed. If a secondary effect was removed, it also removes the user's Life Orb recoil and Shell Bell recovery, and prevents the target's Anger Shell, Berserk, Color Change, Emergency Exit, Pickpocket, Wimp Out, Red Card, Eject Button, Kee Berry, and Maranga Berry from activating.

Sand Force.de: Erhöht in Sandstürmen die Stärke von Gesteins-, Boden- und Stahl-Attacken.
Sand Force.en: If Sandstorm is active, this Pokemon's Ground-, Rock-, and Steel-type attacks have their power multiplied by 1.3. This Pokemon takes no damage from Sandstorm.

Sand Rush.en: If Sandstorm is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled. This Pokemon takes no damage from Sandstorm.

Sand Veil.en: If Sandstorm is active, the accuracy of moves used against this Pokemon is multiplied by 0.8. This Pokemon takes no damage from Sandstorm.

Sand Spit.de: Löst einen Sandsturm aus, wenn das Pokémon von einer Attacke erfasst wird.
Sand Spit.en: When this Pokemon is hit by an attack, the effect of Sandstorm begins.

Sand Stream.de: Erzeugt beim Einwechseln 5 Runden Sandsturm (8 mit Glättstein).
Sand Stream.en: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Sandstorm.

Sharpness.de: This Pokemon's slicing moves have their power multiplied by 1.5.
Sharpness.en: This Pokemon's slicing moves have their power multiplied by 1.5.

Hyper Cutter.de: Hindert Angreifer durch mächtige Scheren daran, den Angriffs-Wert zu senken.
Hyper Cutter.en: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's Attack stat stage.

No Guard.de: Alle Attacken treffen IMMER — vom Träger und gegen ihn.
No Guard.en: Every move used by or against this Pokemon will always hit.

Snow Cloak.en: If Snow is active, the accuracy of moves used against this Pokemon is multiplied by 0.8.

Slush Rush.en: If Snow is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.

Quick Draw.de: Ermöglicht dem Pokémon gelegentlich den Erstschlag.
Quick Draw.en: This Pokemon has a 30% chance to move first in its priority bracket with attacking moves.

Frisk.de: Kann bei Kampfantritt Auskunft über das vom Gegner getragene Item geben.
Frisk.en: On switch-in, this Pokemon identifies the held items of all opposing Pokemon.

Levitate.de: Der Träger ist immun gegen Boden-Attacken, Stachler, Tarnsteine und Giftspitzen.
Levitate.en: This Pokemon is immune to Ground-type attacks and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability. The effects of Gravity, Ingrain, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Iron Ball nullify the immunity. Thousand Arrows can hit this Pokemon as if it did not have this Ability.

Infiltrator.de: Überwindet gegnerische Schilde sowie Delegatoren und greift an.
Infiltrator.en: This Pokemon's moves ignore substitutes and the opposing side's Reflect, Light Screen, Safeguard, Mist, and Aurora Veil.

Armor Tail.de: Vorzugsangriffe gegen den Träger oder seine Verbündeten schlagen fehl.
Armor Tail.en: Priority moves used by opposing Pokemon targeting this Pokemon or its allies are prevented from having an effect.

Heavy Metal.en: This Pokemon's weight is doubled. This effect is calculated after the effect of Autotomize, and before the effect of Float Stone.

Defiant.de: Wenn ein Wert des Trägers durch den Gegner gesenkt wird: Angriff +2.
Defiant.en: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 2 stages for each of its stat stages that is lowered by an opposing Pokemon.

Solar Power.de: Bei harschem Sonnenlicht: Spez.-Angriff ×1,5, aber 1/8 KP-Verlust pro Runde.
Solar Power.en: If Sunny Day is active, this Pokemon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5 and it loses 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn. These effects are prevented if the Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

Thick Fat.de: Das Pokémon wird von einer dicken Fettschicht geschützt, was den durch Feuer- und Eis-Attacken erlittenen Schaden halbiert.
Thick Fat.en: If a Pokemon uses a Fire- or Ice-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon.

Mirror Armor.de: Werte-Senkungen werden auf den Verursacher reflektiert.
Mirror Armor.en: When one of this Pokemon's stat stages would be lowered by another Pokemon, that Pokemon's stat stage is lowered instead. This effect does not happen if this Pokemon's stat stage was already -6. If the other Pokemon has a substitute, neither Pokemon has its stat stage lowered.

Stalwart.de: Ignoriert die Effekte von Fähigkeiten und Attacken anderer Pokémon, die Attacken auf sich lenken.
Stalwart.en: This Pokemon's moves cannot be redirected to a different target by any effect.

Motor Drive.de: Treffer durch Elektro-Attacken verursachen keinen Schaden, sondern geben dem Pokémon eine Starthilfe und erhöhen so seine Initiative.
Motor Drive.en: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Speed by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move.

Static.de: Kann bei Berührung durch statisch aufgeladenen Körper paralysieren.
Static.en: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be paralyzed.

Rock Head.de: Verhindert Schaden, der durch Rückstoß entstehen würde.
Rock Head.en: This Pokemon does not take recoil damage, except Struggle. Does not affect Life Orb damage or crash damage.

Piercing Drill.de: This Pokemon's contact moves ignore a target's protection and deal 1/4 the usual damage.
Piercing Drill.en: This Pokemon's contact moves ignore a target's protection and deal 1/4 the usual damage.

Prankster.de: Status-Attacken erhalten Vorrang (Priorität +1) — wirkungslos gegen Unlicht-Typen.
Prankster.en: This Pokemon's non-damaging moves have their priority increased by 1. Opposing Dark-type Pokemon are immune to these moves, and any move called by these moves, if the resulting user of the move has this Ability.

Torrent.de: Erhöht die Stärke von Wasser-Attacken, wenn die KP auf einen gewissen Wert fallen.
Torrent.en: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Water-type attack.

Sniper.de: Erhöht bei Volltreffern die Stärke der Attacke noch weiter.
Sniper.en: If this Pokemon strikes with a critical hit, the damage is multiplied by 1.5.

Zero to Hero.de: If this Pokemon is a Palafin in Zero Form, switching out has it change to Hero Form.
Zero to Hero.en: If this Pokemon is a Palafin in Zero Form, switching out has it change to Hero Form.

Surge Surfer.de: Verdoppelt die Initiative, wenn zuvor ein Elektrofeld erzeugt wurde.
Surge Surfer.en: If Electric Terrain is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled.

Synchronize.de: Erleidet das Pokémon Verbrennungen, Vergiftungen oder Paralyse, ereilt das jeweilige Statusproblem auch den Verursacher.
Synchronize.en: If another Pokemon burns, paralyzes, poisons, or badly poisons this Pokemon, that Pokemon receives the same non-volatile status condition.

Supersweet Syrup.de: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the evasiveness of opponents 1 stage. Once per battle.
Supersweet Syrup.en: On switch-in, this Pokemon lowers the evasiveness of opponents 1 stage. Once per battle.

Stance Change.de: Aegislash wechselt zwischen Schild- und Klingen-Form je nach eingesetzter Attacke (Angriff → Klinge, Königsschild → Schild).
Stance Change.en: If this Pokemon is an Aegislash, it changes to Blade Forme before using an attacking move, and changes to Shield Forme before using King's Shield.

Cursed Body.de: 30 % Chance, eine treffende Attacke des Gegners für 4 Runden zu sperren.
Cursed Body.en: If this Pokemon is hit by an attack, there is a 30% chance that move gets disabled unless one of the attacker's moves is already disabled.

Technician.de: Erhöht die Stärke von schwächeren Attacken.
Technician.en: This Pokemon's moves of 60 power or less have their power multiplied by 1.5, including Struggle. This effect comes after a move's effect changes its own power.

Telepathy.de: Erkennt und pariert Attacken von Mitstreitern.
Telepathy.en: This Pokemon does not take damage from attacks made by its allies.

Own Tempo.de: Das Pokémon lässt sich nicht aus der Ruhe bringen und verhindert so Verwirrung.
Own Tempo.en: This Pokemon cannot be confused. Gaining this Ability while confused cures it. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

Speed Boost.de: Erhöht in jeder Runde die Initiative.
Speed Boost.en: This Pokemon's Speed is raised by 1 stage at the end of each full turn it has been on the field.

Strong Jaw.de: Der kräftige Kiefer des Pokémon erhöht die Stärke von Biss-Attacken.
Strong Jaw.en: This Pokemon's bite-based attacks have their power multiplied by 1.5.

Klutz.de: Das Pokémon kann keine getragenen Items verwenden.
Klutz.en: This Pokemon's held item has no effect. This Pokemon cannot use Fling successfully. Macho Brace, Power Anklet, Power Band, Power Belt, Power Bracer, Power Lens, and Power Weight still have their effects.

Dry Skin.de: Bei Sonnenschein verliert das Pokémon KP und der Schaden durch Feuer-Attacken steigt. Bei Regen und Treffern durch Wasser-Attacken regeneriert es KP.
Dry Skin.en: This Pokemon is immune to Water-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by a Water-type move. The power of Fire-type moves is multiplied by 1.25 when used on this Pokemon. At the end of each turn, this Pokemon restores 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, if the weather is Rain Dance, and loses 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, if the weather is Sunny Day. The weather effects are prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

Illusion.de: Führt den Gegner hinters Licht, indem es bei Kampfantritt die Gestalt des Pokémon an der letzten Stelle im Team annimmt.
Illusion.en: When this Pokemon switches in, it appears as the last unfainted Pokemon in its party until it takes direct damage from another Pokemon's attack. This Pokemon's actual level and HP are displayed instead of those of the mimicked Pokemon.

Contrary.de: Statusveränderungen werden umgekehrt: Statuswerte, die eigentlich erhöht werden sollten, sinken und umgekehrt.
Contrary.en: If this Pokemon has a stat stage raised it is lowered instead, and vice versa.

Competitive.de: Wenn ein Wert des Trägers durch den Gegner gesenkt wird: Spez.-Angriff +2.
Competitive.en: This Pokemon's Special Attack is raised by 2 stages for each of its stat stages that is lowered by an opposing Pokemon.

Unaware.de: Greift das Pokémon an, ignoriert es sämtliche Statusveränderungen des Zieles.
Unaware.en: This Pokemon ignores other Pokemon's Attack, Special Attack, and accuracy stat stages when taking damage, and ignores other Pokemon's Defense, Special Defense, and evasiveness stat stages when dealing damage.

Sap Sipper.de: Wird es von einer Pflanzen-Attacke getroffen, erleidet es keinerlei Schaden und sein Angriff steigt.
Sap Sipper.en: This Pokemon is immune to Grass-type moves and raises its Attack by 1 stage when hit by a Grass-type move.

Unseen Fist.de: Wenn das Pokémon eine direkte Attacke einsetzt, trifft diese auch dann, wenn sich das Ziel selbst schützt.
Unseen Fist.en: This Pokemon's contact moves ignore the target's protection, except Max Guard.

Gooey.de: Senkt bei Berührung im Zuge eines Angriffs die Initiative des Angreifers.
Gooey.en: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Speed lowered by 1 stage.

Volt Absorb.de: Treffer durch Elektro-Attacken verursachen keinen Schaden, sondern regenerieren stattdessen KP.
Volt Absorb.en: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by an Electric-type move.

Anticipation.en: On switch-in, this Pokemon is alerted if any opposing Pokemon has an attacking move with a type that is super effective against this Pokemon, or any OHKO move. This effect considers Hidden Power to be its determined type, and every other move to be its original type.

Gluttony.de: Setzt bestimmte Beeren nicht erst in einer Notlage ein, sondern bereits dann, wenn seine KP auf die Hälfte des Maximalwerts fallen.
Gluttony.en: When this Pokemon is holding a Berry that usually activates with 1/4 or less of its maximum HP, it is eaten at 1/2 or less of its maximum HP instead.

Protean.de: Das Pokémon nimmt bei Einsatz einer Attacke deren Typ an.
Protean.en: This Pokemon's type changes to match the type of the move it is about to use. This effect comes after all effects that change a move's type. This effect can only happen once per switch-in, and only if this Pokemon is not Terastallized.

Water Bubble.de: Feuer-Attacken fügen dem Pokémon weniger Schaden zu. Verhindert Verbrennungen.
Water Bubble.en: This Pokemon's offensive stat is doubled while using a Water-type attack. If a Pokemon uses a Fire-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon. This Pokemon cannot be burned. Gaining this Ability while burned cures it.

Swift Swim.en: If Rain Dance is active, this Pokemon's Speed is doubled. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

Shadow Tag.de: Hindert Gegner an der Flucht beziehungsweise am Auswechseln, indem es ihnen den Weg versperrt.
Shadow Tag.en: Prevents opposing Pokemon from choosing to switch out, unless they are holding a Shed Shell, are a Ghost type, or also have this Ability.

Skill Link.de: Landet mit Serien-Attacken immer die maximale Anzahl an Treffern.
Skill Link.en: This Pokemon's multi-hit attacks always hit the maximum number of times. Triple Kick and Triple Axel do not check accuracy for the second and third hits.

Cud Chew.de: If this Pokemon eats a Berry, it will eat that Berry again at the end of the next turn.
Cud Chew.en: If this Pokemon eats a Berry, it will eat that Berry again at the end of the next turn.

Cloud Nine.en: While this Pokemon is active, the effects of weather conditions are disabled.

Berserk.de: Spez.-Angriff +1, wenn die KP des Trägers das erste Mal unter 1/2 fallen.
Berserk.en: When this Pokemon has more than 1/2 its maximum HP and takes damage from an attack bringing it to 1/2 or less of its maximum HP, its Special Attack is raised by 1 stage. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability.

Magician.de: Trifft das Pokémon ein Ziel mit einer Attacke, kann es ihm dabei sein Item stehlen.
Magician.en: If this Pokemon has no item, it steals the item off a Pokemon it hits with an attack. Does not affect Doom Desire and Future Sight. If multiple targets are hit by an attack the item is stolen from the fastest Pokemon, while considering the effect of Trick Room and prioritizing opposing Pokemon before allies.

Stall.de: Handelt auch mit Initiative-Vorteil stets als Letztes.
Stall.en: This Pokemon moves last among Pokemon using the same or greater priority moves.

Aerilate.de: Attacken vom Typ Normal nehmen den Typ Flug an und ihre Stärke erhöht sich ein wenig.
Aerilate.en: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Flying-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.

Sweet Veil.en: This Pokemon and its allies cannot fall asleep, but those already asleep do not wake up immediately. This Pokemon and its allies cannot use Rest successfully or become affected by Yawn, and those previously affected will not fall asleep.

Stamina.de: Verteidigung +1, wenn der Träger von einer Attacke getroffen wird.
Stamina.en: This Pokemon's Defense is raised by 1 stage after it is damaged by a move.

Mold Breaker.de: Attacken können ungeachtet der Fähigkeiten des Zieles verwendet werden.
Mold Breaker.en: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore certain Abilities of other Pokemon. The Abilities that can be negated are Armor Tail, Aroma Veil, Aura Break, Battle Armor, Big Pecks, Bulletproof, Clear Body, Contrary, Damp, Dazzling, Disguise, Dry Skin, Earth Eater, Filter, Flash Fire, Flower Gift, Flower Veil, Fluffy, Friend Guard, Fur Coat, Good as Gold, Grass Pelt, Guard Dog, Heatproof, Heavy Metal, Hyper Cutter, Ice Face, Ice Scales, Illuminate, Immunity, Inner Focus, Insomnia, Keen Eye, Leaf Guard, Levitate, Light Metal, Lightning Rod, Limber, Magic Bounce, Magma Armor, Marvel Scale, Mind's Eye, Mirror Armor, Motor Drive, Multiscale, Oblivious, Overcoat, Own Tempo, Pastel Veil, Punk Rock, Purifying Salt, Queenly Majesty, Sand Veil, Sap Sipper, Shell Armor, Shield Dust, Simple, Snow Cloak, Solid Rock, Soundproof, Sticky Hold, Storm Drain, Sturdy, Suction Cups, Sweet Veil, Tangled Feet, Telepathy, Tera Shell, Thermal Exchange, Thick Fat, Unaware, Vital Spirit, Volt Absorb, Water Absorb, Water Bubble, Water Veil, Well-Baked Body, White Smoke, Wind Rider, Wonder Guard, and Wonder Skin. This affects every other Pokemon on the field, whether or not it is a target of this Pokemon's move, and whether or not their Ability is beneficial to this Pokemon.

Hustle.de: Erhöht den Angriffs-Wert, aber senkt die Genauigkeit.
Hustle.en: This Pokemon's Attack is multiplied by 1.5 and the accuracy of its physical attacks is multiplied by 0.8.

Electric Surge.de: Erzeugt beim Einwechseln 5 Runden ein Elektrofeld: Pokémon am Boden können nicht einschlafen, und ihre Elektro-Attacken werden verstärkt.
Electric Surge.en: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Electric Terrain for 5 turns.
